Definition: Alemeth, the name of a place in Palestine and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Alameth or Alemeth = "covering"; n pr m; 1) a Benjamite, son of Jehoadah or Jerah and descended from Saul through Jonathan; 2) a town in Benjamin
